mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_search_history (user_id, keyword, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{keyword}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from voya_ai_search_history where user_id = #{userId} and keyword = #{keyword}
delete from voya_ai_search_history where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select id, keyword, create_time from voya_ai_search_history where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 20

select s.id, s.user_id, s.keyword, s.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url from voya_ai_search_history s left join voya_ai_user u on s.user_id = u.id
and s.keyword like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and u.nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%')
and s.create_time >= #{beginCreateTime}
and s.create_time < date_add(#{endCreateTime}, interval 1 day)
order by s.create_time desc, s.id desc
select s.id, s.user_id, s.keyword, s.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url from voya_ai_search_history s left join voya_ai_user u on s.user_id = u.id where s.id = #{id}
